explication: OnionScan investigates Tor hidden services for operators and researchers. The main workflow accepts onion targets, runs configured protocol checks and web crawling, extracts identity correlations, then emits human-readable or JSON reports. Researchers can also use the correlation-lab web interface to search and tag stored crawl relationships. The graph covers those documented capabilities; some subsystem links rely on imports or README descriptions because their implementation excerpts were not supplied.
